dedupe_keys.name: transportdata be national access point for transport data

description: transportdata.be (national access point for transport data) is a national access point listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Belgian National Access Point for multimodal transport data (FPS Mobility and Transport). The Belgian national access point lists multimodal transport datasets from the federal and regional road and rail bodies, public transport operators and cities: road traffic events and travel times, timetables, rail infrastructure, parking and charging data, many in DATEX II and NeTEx. Coverage: Belgium. The portal lists 194 datasets, each with its own page, publisher, licence and resources. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
